features.text: Dual-hinged support system provides crucial stability for compromised ligaments
Premium neoprene material delivers therapeutic warmth to help reduce joint stiffness
Anatomical design ensures proper tracking and alignment during movement
Professional-grade compression helps reduce swelling and enhances proprioception
Strategic reinforcement zones provide additional support where needed most

measurement: For optimal therapeutic benefits and stability, measure the circumference of your knee at mid-patella (center of kneecap). Visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for detailed sizing guidance and expert fitting assistance.
